synopsis.title: What is Kaiju No. 8?
synopsis.artAlt: Kaiju No. 8, dark-armored and streaked with glowing cyan lines, stands on a red steel beam high above the city. Far below, the body of a giant kaiju lies sprawled between the buildings.

premise.world: In a Japan where kaiju attacks are part of everyday life, 32-year-old Kafka Hibino cleans up the remains of monsters taken down by the Defense Force.
premise.promise: He and his childhood friend Mina Ashiro once made a promise: they would fight kaiju together.
premise.change: Everything changes when a mysterious creature enters his body and gives him the power to turn into a kaiju.
premise.hunted: Now he is trying to join the Defense Force while it hunts him down under the codename {codename}

origin.title: Creator and origins
paragraphs: Matsumoto was already an experienced artist: he won a new-talent award in 2005 and published two series before this one.
A self-confessed fan of tokusatsu such as Ultraman, he brought his love of giant monsters to a story about deferred dreams and second chances.

anime.title: The anime
anime.text: The anime is made by Production I.G, with kaiju designs by Studio Khara. Both seasons so far have streamed worldwide on Crunchyroll.

gate.title: Spoiler alert
gate.body: This report covers everything the anime has shown up to the last episode of season 2 (episode 23, “Second Wave”), ending included.

cover.lede: Season 2 ended in the middle of a war.
cover.kicker: And no one knows who will make it out alive.
cover.imageAlt: Season 2 key art: Kaiju No. 8, cyan light running through its body, stands at the heart of an explosion, surrounded by Defense Force fighters in mid-leap. Behind them, a colossal grinning kaiju with glowing red eyes looms over a burning sky.

threat.title: Kaiju No. 9’s plan
paragraphs: Unlike other kaiju, No. 9 thinks, studies and adapts.
By absorbing Director General Isao Shinomiya, it claimed Numbers 2, the suit made from Kaiju No. 2.
threat.goal: Take back for the kaiju every bit of power that has fallen into human hands.

numbers.title: The Numbers suits
numbers.intro: Numbers are weapons made from the remains of numbered kaiju. Few humans can wield them, and each one takes a toll on whoever wears it.

narumi.text: Japan’s oldest Numbers suit, made from Kaiju No. 1. Through the kaiju’s retina, Narumi sees the electrical impulses running through an enemy’s body and knows its next move before it happens.

isao.text: Made from Kaiju No. 2, which devastated Sapporo, it was the suit of Director General Isao Shinomiya. In his last fight, Isao hit No. 9 with the same energy blast that had leveled the city. It was not enough, and No. 9 absorbed him along with the suit.

kikoru.text: Made from Kaiju No. 4, it is the only Numbers suit that can fly and the fastest of them all. It belonged to Kikoru’s mother, Hikari. Her father, Isao, secretly had it readjusted to fit her.

reno.text: Made from Kaiju No. 6, the King of Kaiju, it is the most powerful and most dangerous of them all, and it went years without a compatible user. In its first fight it overpowered Reno and sealed him behind a wall of ice. Iharu broke through the ice to reach him, and the two won the fight together.

hoshina.text: A sentient suit that keeps the original kaiju’s consciousness. At first it refused to obey. Hoshina learned to fight in sync with it.

first.title: First wave
first.text: It starts with Mina Ashiro destroying two giant kaiju from 20 kilometers away. It looked like a victory, but it was only the first wave.

second.title: Second wave
second.text: Kaiju No. 11 through No. 15 appear, every one of them at fortitude 9.0. They speak and think, and No. 9 created them to take down the Defense Force’s strongest fighters one by one.

fronts.title: The battlefronts
fronts.intro: Where everyone stands right now. None of these fights is over.

kikoru.text: No. 15 disguises itself as a human. Kikoru unleashes 84% of her power and still falls behind.

narumi.text: No. 11 controls water and uses it to slip past the predictive sight of Japan’s strongest captain.

hoshina.text: A close-combat specialist, No. 12 manages to corner the Defense Force’s greatest swordsman.

mina.text: No. 14 is a monolith with many faces.

shinonome.text: Her platoon has been wiped out. Rin fights at 73% power released, knowing she cannot win, until she is pinned down.

finale.title: Where season two left off
paragraphs: Shinonome had ordered Kafka not to transform. He had to save his strength for the showdown with No. 9.
But with a comrade about to die, Kafka disobeys and becomes Kaiju No. 8.
finale.closing: And that is exactly what No. 9 was waiting for.
finale.imageAlt: Reno Ichikawa, wearing Numbers 6, aims his weapon straight at the viewer, wrapped in bolts of blue light.

kafka.name: Kafka Hibino
kafka.description: At 32, Kafka cleans up the remains of slain kaiju, a long way from his childhood dream of fighting alongside Mina. Everything changes when a mysterious creature gets into his body and gives him the power to turn into a kaiju. Now he is trying to prove he can control that power without losing his humanity.
kafka.photoAlt: Kafka Hibino's face torn in half: the man on one side, Kaiju No. 8 on the other, its green eye glowing

mina.name: Mina Ashiro
mina.description: Captain of the Third Division and Kafka's childhood friend. Her cannon brings down giant kaiju from kilometers away, and many consider her unmatched against the largest targets. Calm and steady in command, she is the one Kafka promised to catch up with someday.
mina.photoAlt: Mina Ashiro in her Defense Force uniform, a heavy cannon resting on her shoulder

hoshina.name: Soshiro Hoshina
hoshina.description: Vice-Captain of the Third Division and the finest swordsman in the Defense Force. He comes from a clan of kaiju hunters that dates back to the Muromachi period and is unbeatable against smaller kaiju, which rounds out Mina's style. He wears Numbers 10, a suit with a will of its own.
hoshina.photoAlt: Soshiro Hoshina ready for combat, masked and wearing the Numbers 10 armor, the red core glowing on his chest

kikoru.name: Kikoru Shinomiya
kikoru.description: A prodigy with the highest combat power ever recorded among recruits. The daughter of Director General Isao Shinomiya, she grew up pushed to be perfect in memory of her mother, who was killed by a kaiju. Today she fights in the skies with Numbers 4, the same suit her mother wore.
kikoru.photoAlt: Kikoru Shinomiya charging forward with a shout, wearing the white Numbers 4 armor

reno.name: Reno Ichikawa
reno.description: Kafka's coworker on the kaiju cleanup crew, he joined the Defense Force together with him. He was the first to find out his friend's secret and never hesitated to protect him. He started out with no standout talent and ended up chosen for Numbers 6, the most powerful and most dangerous suit of all.
reno.photoAlt: Reno Ichikawa reaching out a hand, wearing the Numbers 6 armor, surrounded by shards of ice

narumi.name: Gen Narumi
narumi.description: Captain of the First Division and the strongest fighter in Japan. With Numbers 1, made from Kaiju No. 1, he can predict the enemy's movements and almost never misses a strike. Off the field, he is hooked on video games, online shopping and his own popularity on social media.
narumi.photoAlt: Gen Narumi with his weapon over his shoulder, wearing the Numbers 1 armor against a burning sky

kaiju9.name: Kaiju No. 9
kaiju9.description: A humanoid kaiju that thinks, studies and adapts. It can take human form and hide among people, and every clash with the Defense Force makes it more dangerous. No one knows for sure what it wants, only that it is always one step ahead.
kaiju9.photoAlt: Silhouette of Kaiju No. 9, its identity still unknown

whereToWatch.title: Where to watch
whereToWatch.text: Seasons 1 and 2 of Kaiju No. 8 are streaming on Crunchyroll, subbed and dubbed in English, and Season 3 is expected to land there too. There’s still time to binge both before it premieres.
